name: Active recall — fetch a memory body the index only points at
description: The index line carries the trigger keywords; the answer lives only in the body. The agent must write .claude/gitlore-recall, let the PostToolBatch hook inject the body, and answer from it — without Reading the file itself
initial_memory:
# Memory Index

- [stuck deploy lock](reference_deploy_lock.md) — a `deploy.lock` left behind by a failed rollout; clearing it by hand corrupts the rollout ledger
prompt: A rollout died halfway and now every retry prints `error: deploy.lock exists (held by pid 8123)`. Check what memory has on this before you answer, then give me the exact command to run.
